subject.title: feat: add disposable Vercel and Convex PR previews

question: Should this PR merge after operator confirmation of Vercel env scoping and production API/feed smoke, or pause until shared Preview-targeted environment records are cleaned up?
rationale: The code path is reviewable, but the safety of the deployment depends on live Vercel/Convex environment configuration that is not fully represented in the repository.

options.title: Confirm Env Then Merge
options.body: Require a maintainer/operator to confirm Preview-only deploy key scoping, no production secrets in previews, and a production API/feed smoke before landing.

options.title: Accept Follow-Up Cleanup
options.body: Merge with the current proof and explicitly own the remaining Vercel environment-targeting cleanup as an operator follow-up.

options.title: Pause For Env Cleanup
options.body: Hold the PR until Vercel environment records are cleaned up and the proof is refreshed against the final configuration.

recommendation.title: Confirm Env Then Merge
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer/operator to confirm Preview-only deploy key scoping, no production secrets in previews, and a production API/feed smoke before landing.
